wish: someone should make an app that converts cooking measures, like 40g of sugar to mL
spec:
Converts an amount of a chosen ingredient between weight (g, kg, oz, lb) and volume (mL, L, tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz) using per-ingredient densities.
Type an amount, tap its unit, tap the ingredient; every other unit updates, plus a cup-and-spoon measure you can scoop.
Does not cover every ingredient, metric or imperial cups, or how tightly something is packed beyond the typical values listed.
notes: Densities are typical grams per US cup (spooned flour, packed brown sugar). Fractions like 1/2 and 1 1/2 are accepted as amounts.
